           CASCARA SAGRADA

         Sacred Bark

        (RHAMNUS PURSHIANA)


Introduced as a palliative for constipation (non-homeopathic), fifteen
        drops of fluid extract here it restores normal function by its tonic effects, but it has a
        wider sphere of action, as careful provings will show. Chronic indigestion, cirrhosis and
        jaundice. Hæmorrhoids and constipation. Gastric headache. Broad, flabby tongue; foul
        breath.



Urine.--  Must wait for minute before flow starts then first in
        drops.



Extremities.--    Rheumatism of muscles
        and joints, with obstinate constipation  .



Relationship.--  Compare:   Hyd; Nux;
        Rhamnus Californica   (tincture for constipation; tympanites and appendicitis and
        especially   rheumatism  ).



Dose.--  Tincture to sixth potency.
